items.title: Discover Indoor GIS at Esri Infrastructure Management and GIS 2026 Conference
items.summary: The 2026 Esri Infrastructure Management & GIS (IMGIS) Conference brings together infrastructure professionals to learn how geographic information system (GIS) technology supports planning, operations, and asset management across the infrastructure lifecycle.

items.title: Trump Unveils Super Intelligence Force for AI Safety
items.summary: Trump Unveils Super Intelligence Force for AI Safety New government task force addresses growing AI safety concerns and regulation PUBLISHED: Sun, Oct 4, 2026, 3:37 PM UTC | UPDATED: Sun, Oct 4, 2026, 3:37 PM UTC Former President Trump announced the creation of a "Super Intelligence Force" today, marking his administration's most significant response to escalating debates over artificial intelligence safety and regulation.

items.title: Why India Needs A Unique AI Safety Framework
items.summary: As India navigates the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence, industry experts advocate for a bespoke AI safety framework, urging a departure from foreign models to address unique challenges like deepfakes and cyberattacks while fostering innovation.

items.title: Bessent Compares AI Safety-Warning CEOs to Hannibal Lecter
items.summary: On October 3, Bessent used the line on The Axios Show, aiming it at Anthropic's Dario Amodei days after rejecting a liability shield for AI labs over a 10% extinction-risk estimate from researcher Evan Hubinger.
